notes_for_editor: Existence and standing rest on two lists: the Tennessee Landforms list (revised January 2026) and the 2014 National Register extant table. Dotsonville is not on the NHLR Tennessee list. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, fire history or access information was found in the cache or in two web searches, so the story is short. The record's county, elevation (647 ft, 197.2 m) and standing status match the sources; no corrections proposed. The list's code 6-12 is reported as the list gives it. Page reads: about 5 across the three lookouts' shared sources.
